scope: One fixed development-only JPEG cause/preprocessing check and minimal class generation feasibility. Not new confirmation.
word_policy: FROZEN. No editing, overwriting, copying as a new version, or invoking taskbook writers without explicit user request.

word_reference.archive_path: protocol/网页截图的细微变更分类｜实验任务书_v1.1.docx

input_roles.excluded: All6 confirmation families and419 opened pairs; historical155,355 and72 controls.

jpeg_experiment.reuse: run05 fixed local descriptors and fitted learned detector; no refit or candidate method search
jpeg_experiment.candidate_preprocessing: JPEG roundtrip quality90 applied independently once to both received frames. If received after is already JPEG95, it is encoded again. One candidate only.
jpeg_experiment.threshold_calibration: Scalar local_max32: separately in each pipeline, max95th higher quantile over train-family unique baseline negatives in four calibration conditions. Frozen learned gate: keep existing run05 threshold unchanged in every pipeline; do not recalibrate it. Development is readout only.
jpeg_experiment.positive_selection: On development families only, choose one original pair per(family,label), prefer level1 then0 then2, then lexicographic baseline_id/id. No replacement based on scores.
jpeg_experiment.causal_diagnostic: Compare PNG vs JPEG(q) same baseline with JPEG(q) vs JPEG(q) matched encoding. Matched pairs are a construction sanity check, not a deployed repair. Also compare matched-encoded changed pairs atq95.
jpeg_experiment.interpretation: A candidate counts as development signal only if worst FPR falls without reducing clean or JPEG95 positive recall. Any gain remains development only; no further candidates or tuning.

generation_check.position_rule: Existing visible non-inline boxes with visible fill or border; choose area ascending. Translate existing transform by1/2/4px. Do not add elements or content.
generation_check.justify_rule: Existing visible horizontal nowrap flex containers with>=2 visible children and measured unused width>=8px; choose DOM order. Reuse original justify-content operator.
generation_check.policy: Pixel eligibility check only, no model scores. Compare generated pixel hashes to existing development labels to expose collisions. No mutation of run05 corpus. If no target, record required source-layout conditions.
